about: Screen builds: shots = the 30 s cut (cut30 seconds), cut15_shots = the 15 s cut (cut15 seconds). Times are cut seconds (src = source seconds). Sheets are 390x844 pt drawn at 3x. scroll_pt = how far the tall page is scrolled (pt, 0 = top). Positions are % of the phone screen (x from left, y from top) unless they say frame. Phone on set/loc_screen_backdrop.jpg. SMALL = whole phone visible, centred, outer x 37.6-62.4% of frame, y 3.8-96.1%. ZOOM = 1.40x SMALL (phone 34.9% of frame width, x 32.5-67.3%), cropped by the frame: ZOOM top keeps the phone top at y 4.1%, ZOOM low keeps its bottom at y 94%. Phone geometry and the bezel PNG: see phone. Every scale change is ease-in-out. Taps are a soft grey touch circle (56 pt, 35% grey, 0.25 s fade in/out); taps and scrolls are silent.

shots.notes: Thread at its end: the flight-price message (no reaction yet), the user reply, Muse's reply above "+ Message"; chat tab selected. Nothing in the screen moves.

camera.move: push in SMALL -> ZOOM, anchored low: phone bottom edge ends at frame y 94%, top cropped

phone.what: Drawn bezel, measured on the source: 1254x2616 px RGBA at 3x (418x872 pt), #181818 bezel, transparent screen. Clip a 1170x2532 ui_*.png sheet to a rounded rectangle with 155 px (51.6 pt) corners (the sheets are square-cornered and would poke out past the bezel), lay it in the screen hole at (42, 42) px under the bezel, then scale the pair as one.

small_1280x720.note: x, y, w, h: phone outer box at SMALL (scale 0.763 px per pt at 720p; 1.144 at 1080p)

phone.shadow: soft shadow all round, no offset: black at 18% opacity, gaussian blur about 20 px at 720p (30 px at 1080p); it darkens the backdrop about 10% right at the bezel and fades out within 40 px
phone.tap: grey touch circle 56 pt (#8c8c8c at 35%), 0.25 s fade in and out, silent
